summary.text: Sword Dragon Transformation is Fang Yuan's transformation path immortal killer move. With change form Immortal Gu as the core, it turns him into a sword path sword dragon.

claims.text: After refining a dead sword path desolate beast sword dragon into supporting mortal Gu, Fang Yuan activates the move around change form Immortal Gu and becomes a slender silver sword dragon with white eyes and sharp aura. The composition needs dragon scale Gu, dragon horn Gu, dragon claw Gu, dragon eyes Gu, and related worms; if any of those is Immortal Gu, the move is immortal, but with change form as a transformation path core he can keep the dragon parts at mortal rank. As a wisdom path grandmaster he also improves the cast so the transformation is faster and more nimble, using Han Dong’s leftover land spirit insights on spirit snake transformation as reference. Maintaining the form costs little green grape immortal essence while only rank six change form is involved.

In sword dragon form he gains desolate beast level qualities far beyond a human body. The sword dragon is slender and nimble: the power of its tail surpasses its two small claws, and above the power of its tail is its speed, a strong burst from a standstill, easier to redirect than his blood path movement killer move blood torrent, though still below sword escape Immortal Gu. Its strongest weapon is dragon breath, which can cut subterranean adamantite, among the hardest rank six immortal materials, in two.

He chose the transformation partly because Lang Ya Sect’s treasury held rank seven dragon breath Immortal Gu, and after integrating that Gu the form becomes an ancient desolate beast level sword dragon over forty feet long with four claws, able to match rank seven Gu Immortals, at much higher immortal essence cost.
At the blood battle martial competition he fights Ye Lui Qun Xing in that ancient form, showing proficient control as he arcs past star fragments and smashes them with his tail.

He closes with sword escape Immortal Gu, breathes dragon breath, and kills Ye Lui Qun Xing, then judges the form a classic case of strong offense and weak defense with an extreme imbalance between the two.
